title: S2.1 - Define the versioned .ipm package with binary attachments
body:
## Objective
Define a portable, versioned `.ipm` package able to carry the project portfolio and real binary attachments after the JSON snapshot synchronization flow is stable.

## Prerequisites
- R1.7 and S1.1 through S1.5 are complete
- real Windows and Android feedback is available
- the global JSON bundle schema remains supported

## Design scope
- package manifest and explicit format version
- embedded portfolio bundle
- blobs identified by content hash
- attachment metadata and project references
- safe import validation and migration strategy
- forward/unknown-version behavior

## Constraints
- do not start implementation before S1 is validated
- preserve plain JSON import/export as a fallback
- do not silently extract or overwrite files
- no multi-user or access-control model

## Validation
- a written format specification exists
- corrupted or unknown packages fail safely
- duplicate blobs have deterministic handling
- rollback and migration paths are documented

## Rollback
- revert the format specification; no runtime or user data changes are included
